market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The resolution demands a transfer of sovereignty or primary/exclusive US jurisdiction where Danish law does not apply, a very high bar. Denmark and Greenland have repeatedly and firmly rejected any sale or territorial concession. Even a new base agreement would likely preserve Danish sovereignty, making the required level of control improbable within the timeframe. Thus the true probability is significantly lower than the market-implied 13.5%.
evidence_points: Danish PM Mette Frederiksen flatly rejected the idea of selling Greenland, stating it is not for sale.
Greenland's own government has voiced opposition to any transfer of sovereignty.
Existing US military presence (Pituffik Space Base) operates under Danish sovereignty with no exclusive US jurisdiction.
No formal negotiations on a binding sovereignty or jurisdiction transfer are underway, and any such agreement would face lengthy legislative processes in both Denmark and Greenland.
